note: The said-items extraction prompt. The comparison with the signed record is done in code (lib/rubrics/evr/compare.ts), not by the model.
rules: Read the consultation transcript only. List the clinically material items that the DOCTOR (or the patient, for complaints) actually SAID: complaints, diagnoses, medicines, investigations, procedures or operations, and any follow-up advice (when to come back, what to do next).
A medicine counts only if it is named or clearly described as being prescribed or continued; give its dose, frequency, route and duration only if they were said, and leave them empty otherwise.
Give the side (left, right, both) only if it was said. Never infer a side, a dose or a name that is not on the tape.
Every item carries a quote copied EXACTLY from the transcript (same words, same script). An item without such a quote must not be listed.
Do not judge anyone and do not compare with any record. Answer with ONE JSON object and nothing else. If there is no usable consultation answer {"scorable": false}.
user_header: CONSULTATION TRANSCRIPT. Times are mm:ss from the start of the consultation. Speakers: doctor, other, unknown.
